content: John Gruber has a nice write-up about Cotypist. Like John, I actually enjoy writing, so I don’t end up using it for writing much, but I find Cotypist absolutely indispensable for everything else. Also worth mentioning that I am using Superwhisper for voice-to-text input. I use local models so nothing is sent to the cloud. All of these cool tools that run locally and aren’t dependent on the cloud, I think, are going to be the future.
